decisions.rationale: Current monthly earnings statement (annualizes to about $68,500) and 2025 NOA ($69,282) support the stated $69,000.
Seasoned chequing history of about four months with a $98,383 closing balance covers the $81,000 down payment plus closing costs, with no large or unusual deposits.
Meridian Real Estate Appraisers is on the panel, report dated 2026-07-26 is recent, and the $816,000 value supports the $810,000 price.
GDS about 32.7% and TDS about 36.8% (condo fees counted in full) on the $5,750 monthly income are within 39%/44%, and the score of 765 exceeds 600.
